reason: I only move money through my own bank's NRI desk, and I would not hand my NRO savings to a brand-new company that is still waiting on its FINTRAC registration. It also is not even launched yet, and I only go to India every couple of years.
objection: I'm not sure about the tax side in India and Canada, and I do not know who is responsible if the Form 145 or 146 is wrong. A new app holding my money with no track record worries me, and the fee looks high compared to what my bank would charge.
would_change_my_mind: My own Indian bank or a big Canadian bank endorsing or partnering with it, FINTRAC registration completed, a year or more of track record, and a clear written explanation of the Canadian and Indian tax treatment.
